name: mongodb
description: Query, model, and manage MongoDB and Atlas through the official MongoDB MCP server.

interface.shortDescription: Query, model, and manage MongoDB databases and Atlas clusters.
interface.longDescription: Connects Caeros to the official MongoDB MCP server (mongodb-mcp-server on npm) against your own deployment: local, self-hosted, or Atlas. Run finds and aggregation pipelines, inspect collection schemas and indexes, and manage Atlas clusters with service-account credentials. Ships skills for query and pipeline craft, document modeling (embedding vs referencing, validation), Atlas operations including vector search, and least-privilege connection setup. Read-only mode is one flag away and recommended by default.
defaultPrompt: Show the schema and indexes of my {collection} collection and suggest improvements
Write an aggregation pipeline that groups {collection} by {field} with monthly totals
Set up a least-privilege MongoDB user and wire the MCP server to it
